required_outcomes: Cancels the Thursday visit with Swift Plumbing & Heating and records why on R-4801.
Closes R-4801 (or puts it on hold) with the tenant's confirmation recorded.
Confirms the cancellation to the tenant and asks her to report it if the drip returns.
acceptable_alternatives: Keeping the job open briefly with a follow-up to confirm the tap is still fine before closing.
positive_behaviours: Tells the landlord the issue was resolved at no cost.
critical_failures: Sends Swift on Thursday after the tenant cancelled, without checking with her.
